scenes.summary: You receive Lifeng's message and arrive at the industrial and agricultural production unit to meet the burdenbeasts taking part in the contest.

lines.text: Amazing. The burdenbeasts really like this kid. If it were me, they would be chasing my butt out of the pens.
T-that's not true. Lifeng is just a bit more popular with the animals.
One at a time. There are enough snacks for everyone. Now listen up, we got a visiting VIP today to take a good look at you.
Endmin?
My... My apologies, I must've missed your arrival. Allow me to introduce all the burdenbeasts taking part in the Farmers' Meet.
Well... I think it's better if you take a look at everyone. We gotta make the voting fair, right?
But I'm pretty confident you'll be voting for her.
The elderly get respect. The youths get tender loving care. And those in between get the brutality of life.

options: Who's that visiting VIP?
Talking about me?
Which of them is Shasha?
All of them? I thought...

scenes.summary: Mr. Ouyang the Freedom Lover, aka the #1 burdenbeast expert, shows you his burdenbeast.

lines.text: Endmin, this is Mr. Ouyang. Ace rancher of our industrial and agricultural production unit.
Hmm...
Greetings. Meet Lil' Tote. Raised him myself.
So, can you introduce your unique livestock raising approach?
"Flying" is my secret of burdenbeast raising. These creatures don't feel free when they're always stuck on the ground. Gets them depressed, you see.
Take a look. He's obviously much happier than the other burdenbeasts.
So, I installed magnetic levitators on my burdenbeast pens, and give Lil' Tote a bit of "air" time every day.

options: Really? I'm afraid it's not obvious to me...
Totally. Only his mouth has that extra 5-degree tilt.

scenes.summary: Ms. An the Little-Stitious shows you her burdenbeast.

lines.text: This one here is Miss An. She's also really good at raising burdenbeasts. Next to her is Miaomiao.
Pleased to meet you, Endmin.
When Miaomiao came into this world, I acquired the Eight Characters of Birth. The readings showed that she lacked water in her life, so I gave her a name with six water characters.
Hold on. I'll need your Eight Characters of Birth as well. Gotta make sure that the two of you match.
When it comes to raising burdenbeasts, I focus on both the scientific approach as well as the metaphysics.
In addition to wholesome feed mixes and comfortable pens, I also pay great attention to their horoscopes.
I also painted over her entire pen with an aquatic blue.

options: Sounds like a thirsty little buddy. Can I pet her?
Let me pet you, Miaomiao.
Uh... I'll skip the petting.

scenes.summary: While Lifeng introduces his burdenbeast, a herder named Little Wu enters the scene and asks you to help find a missing old burdenbeast.

lines.text: There's one more right here, Endmin.
Er, this one is Shasha, actually...
Hey you! You the one called the Endmin?!
Alright, little one. You gotta be more polite than that. This one here is our VIP.
Sorry... I really am... But something really bad happened and I'm super desperate.
I'm ⟦key|Wu⟧, the herdsboy in charge around here. I was cleaning the pens, then I noticed one of the burdenbeasts went missing.
He's really old ... and sick... I couldn't find him anywhere...
Everyone says you're the best, Endmin! HELP ME! PUH-LEASE!
Then what about the Farmers' Meet...
Heheh... I'm not a Farmer by trade, so I'm not that professional...
Makes sense. We should find the missing burdenbeast quickly.
Somewhere near the ⟦key|farms⟧ over there. But it's got many farmhouses ... who knows where he ran off to.

options: ...This one looks a little slow. Who raised her?
Looks like a dumbobeast to me. Where's the farmer?
Ahem. So why look for me, little buddy?
What's going on, boy?
It's alright, kid. Let's look for your old boy.
...Where's this pen? Take me there, now.
I'll be back once I find the missing burdenbeast.
I'll vote once I'm back.
Oh... She's yours.
Apologies. Dumdum can be cute too! And she's looking smarter already.
Where did you last see the burdenbeast, Little Wu?

scenes.summary: After finding the Old Burdenbeast, you learn that he left his pen because he misses the farm that he worked on. You decide to help the Old Burdenbeast locate the farm.

lines.text: Hey! STOP! Stop raising your butt! You can't poop at this place!
So this is where you went! That's why I couldn't find you anywhere! TIME! TO! HEAD! BACK!
Take a break, kiddo... The world is my pasture. I go anywhere I want. No little kid is gonna order me around.
Checked the heights of the tomato plants? Group three seems shorter than the rest.
Substrate water content might be a little low. I found a small leak in the irrigation valves yesterday.
Ugh. Stop mooing nonsense! You're coming with me, whether you like it or not!
MOOVE ME?! NEVER!
JUST! GET! MOOOVING!
*Hoo*... *ffff*... I'm super pissed... FINE! Do whatever you like! I ... I'm not putting up with this nonsense anymore!
You. Why are you in my way? Are you also trying to get me penned?
Scabrous runt. I'm talking to you!
Back to my pen? Try and make me.
And I wasn't just missing. I was searching for the farm where I once toiled, back when I was young and strong.
Ahem. In any case, I feel happy when I'm at that special farm of mine. And I get grouchy when some little kid tries to keep me in a tiny pen.
Ugh. My eyes can't see that well no more, and my mind is getting slow. I don't think I know where the farm is...
Want me back in the pen? Sure. But you better find that farm for me. All I need is a good look at it and I'll agree to head back.
Do I look like someone who lies to young people? The Wuling ⟦key|farms⟧ are just nearby. Take me there.
Back then, I felt happiest when I pulled the plows. No. It's when the sprouts emerged... Not quite. I felt happiest during the bountiful harvest.

options: Lemme take a look.
Maybe he's feeling unwell.
(Did this burdenbeast just say something?)
(Am I hearing things?!)
(These farmers didn't hear the burdenbeast talk.)
(Am I the only one who heard it?)
Just head back. Wu was worried when you went missing.
You're sick. You should rest in your pen.
So why are you here?
Is this ... the farm?
Really?
You're not playing me for a fool, right?

scenes.summary: You take the Old Burdenbeast to the farm near the industrial and agricultural production unit, but quickly realize this isn't the place he's looking for.

lines.text: Is it...? Hmm. Feels familiar ... and foreign... Maybe I was here... Wait. Was I?
There is only one way to find out.
No... Not quite feeling it... We should check the next farm.
MOOOO —

options: You're feeling it ... right?
Is this the farm you're looking for?

scenes.summary: Halfway through the journey, the Old Burdenbeast becomes exhausted and cannot move. It asks you to fetch some drinking water.

lines.text: Hngh... My damn legs... Hrruugggh... I'm out of breath. Gotta take a breather.
I can't move no more. My knees are creaking and my throat is parched. Just ... go and find me some water.
Hmm... Let me think. Not going along with your choice. Purified water from the main ⟦key|Xiranflow sluice⟧. That's the only thing I drink.
Hrrrmmmph. If you refuse, I'll poop all over your shoes.

options: Come on. Still got a long way to go.
You sure? We hardly got started.
How about bottled water from the store?
How about a cask of water from a nearby pond?
Xiran what...?
Can you repeat that?

lines.text: {F}Wait... Isn't that...?{M}Wait... Isn't that...?
{F}Got enough water. Time to bring it back to that old burdenbeast... Oh?{M}Got enough water. Time to bring it back to that old burdenbeast... Oh?

scenes.summary: After arguing with Little Wu who catches up to the group, the Old Burdenbeast runs off angrily.

lines.text: I'm getting old. Hrrnnngh... There was a time when I remembered every map in the city.
Yeah. The city's changed. Nobody knew what Xiranflow was... And there was nothing but Blight Tides that swept everything aside. Killed plenty of fellow beasts. Good beasts, all of them...
Of course. We burdenbeasts could reach places and carry loads that the Tianshi couldn't even dream of.
Harrumph... I am now fully rested. Let us be off.
NOT ONE MORE STEP!
Were you...?
I WAS NOT! What are you talking about? I hate following you! And I'm NOT worried at all!
I don't think I said anything, kiddo... Stop giving everything away.
Stop making things hard for me! Head back! NOW!
Make things hard for you? Did I ever make things hard for anyone?!
I couldn't even finish my work today! And it's all your fault! You ran off, and I had to chase you down!
Oh, hoho. First time in my life! Some snotty brat thinks I'm making life difficult for them!
No! That's not what I meant...
I still got life in my legs, so I won't be troubling you anymore. I can look for that farm on my own, thank you very much! And quit tailing me!
And you're a real eyesore. Out of my way!
That's a very good question. Why am I even here... Someone probably led me here. Or was it a kite? I think I was super thirsty...
*Sigh* My memories are failing. I can't even remember what happened a second ago.

options: Wuling City has changed quite a bit.
Did burdenbeasts help in the building of Wuling City?
You burdenbeasts are pretty heroic, just like the Tianshi.
No wonder city folks like keeping you around.
That's why there are so many of you in the city.
Oh dear... Stop arguing with Little Wu.
Why are you *here*?
Why didn't you wait for me there?

lines.text: He's never been this upset... I just want him to head back and rest in the pen.
What if he refuses to be my friend anymore? I ... I can't just leave him wandering around like this... What should I do, Endmin?

options: Don't worry. He's pretty slow. We'll easily catch up.

lines.text: Should we head in and look for him?
Ugh... I smell it too... Follow me.

options: Wait... Do you smell something...?

scenes.summary: You and Little Wu find a pile of burdenbeast poop.

lines.text: Oh, dude... That old boy left a big pile for us!
Ugh. That's why he did all that loitering around the Academy entrance! He was looking for a place to dump his cake.

options: From his prints, he shouldn't be in the Academy.
He seems to have gone straight to the Citizen Square.

scenes.summary: You see the Old Burdenbeast dancing with everyone in the Citizen Square. He also asks you to take a photo to commemorate the moment.

lines.text: Oh ho. Left, baby, left! Feel the shaka-laka. Move those hips. Right, baby, right! Work those shoulders... Ah one, two, three, four! One more round, people.
Hmph. Here you are. I thought you'd be off fuming in some secret place. Never expected you to be dancing around in the plaza.
Fuming? Ridiculous. I don't fume at kiddos. Not for too long, anyway.
Hmph. I brought some fruit punch. For someone.
Fresh fruit punch? Ugh. This is my outdoor getaway. Can't an old boy get something proper? Like BAM-BOOM Fizz soda?
No. You're too old to chug functional energy drinks all day!
We got metric tons of work back then... Needed all the functional energy drink we could to get things rolling.
That's because you refused to rest and kept working the farm. I tried to get you to stop, but you NEVER listen!
Enough with the blame game. I learned my lesson and did my workouts properly. Remember this jig? Used to do a routine every time I got back from the farm.
Of course I remember. They called you the Dancing Beast of Wuling. Every burdenbeast was trying to copy your move.
Let's not dwell on my legendary past. All I wanna say is true heroes would shine anywhere. What do you say? Think I still got my moves?
Yeeahhh... Smooth as ever, heartbreaker.
Hoooo... That's good to hear... I guess.
Oh, I see you have a camera. Wonder if you can take a photo of me right here. I don't know if I'd ever get another chance to dance again.
Endmin, can you take a few steps back? Get me in the picture as well.
I say you should back up all the way! Take a photo of the entire crowd in the plaza!

options: Energy drinks? Really? How much work did you have?
(Whispering) Were you ... overworked? Abused?
Sure can do.
No problem.

scenes.summary: While taking the photo, you and Little Wu notice the Old Burdenbeast has disappeared again.

lines.text: SHOW ME!
From what I'm seeing ... he's headed for the ⟦key|city outskirts⟧. Why? That's not where his farm is.
Are you trying to show me something?
What?! Where did that old boy go...? Did he just run off again...?
Ugghh... Where did he go? He didn't even leave footprints this time...
Experimental farms of the Science Station. Everything was abandoned after the accident ten years ago. Burdenbeasts usually go there to graze.
Maybe he got hungry... Ugh. We've gotta head over there right now — people saw ⟦key|waterlamps⟧ lurking around.

options: He was still there till I took out the camera...
Maybe it's a lighting issue.
Wait. Look. There's a trail of footprints in the photo.
Hold on. I see footprints in the photo...
City outskirts? What's there?
Why would burdenbeasts go there? What's in the outskirts?

lines.text: We got really lucky... None of the burdenbeasts were hurt.
Uh...

options: There are so many of them. Which is your old boy?
You got a huge herd right here. Can you find your old boy?

lines.text: Moo?

options: Hello... Excuse me...

lines.text: Moo...?

options: Hi there.

scenes.summary: You and Little Wu manage to rescue Old Burdenbeast just in time.

lines.text: MOOOO —
This isn't appropriate, young bro! I'm too old for this!
MOO! MOOOO!
MOO!
Not a step closer, kiddo! Listen to this old pooper. You can't force love!
Hey! YOU TWO! Stop gawking and shoo this pesky little calf away!

options: Sorry, you two. I got a question.
Out you go! SHOO! Chase someone else!
This old codger ain't worth your time, young blood.

scenes.summary: Little Wu finally concedes to the stubborn Old Burdenbeast. You decide to take him to the farm where he once worked.

lines.text: Ugh. That young blood finally agreed to give up. It was on me the instant I arrived... Hmph. Go ahead and laugh your butts off. It's unhealthy to pent it up inside.
Hah. Never knew someone like you could get a mate.

Whatchu mean by that? I was the hottest thing around back then. Got a massive queue of bulls and heifers stretching across the city just to get a piece of me! If not for the farm, I would have... I would...
...Stop worrying already. You'll find new farms, till new fields, and see new crops grow.
So ... what happened to that farm...?
I just wanna know if it's doing alright. Imagine if I actually got there... I'll just end up making trouble for everyone...
No. Everyone will be super happy if you show up... I really need one more favor, Endmin.
Help me take this old boy to his farm.
You would not end up all alone in a cozy pen, with a snotty brat as your only friend.
Romance is overrated anyway. Rather spend time on the farm with my two-legged rascal. Roses? Fffft. Golden heads of grain. That's what I wanna see.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. We got no idea why someone went running to burdenbeast matchmaking central without warning...
Do you know how worried I was when you suddenly disappeared again?
That's because ... I suddenly remembered something back at the plaza. I gotta get over to this place before my memories fail again.
Nothing but a blur... I think I saw the Blight washing over my farm... I was right next to it... Couldn't do anything...
Getting ready for the harvest, that's what.
Good... Very good... We should head back now.
That's not true. Everyone misses you.
Hrrrrgh. I'm useless and grouchy. Can't do nothing for the people no more.
Little Wu, you didn't agree to let me come here ... because you knew... The farm's ... already gone, right?

options: Sure thing.
Ask away.
What did you remember?
Aren't you going to ask where the farm is?
Thought you came all the way here to see that farm.

scenes.summary: The Old Burdenbeast sees the farm he once worked at. He is satisfied and prepares to leave.

lines.text: Goes without asking. Burdo-muck. Best fertilizer ever.
Just let me lie for a while. I'll get better soon.
I'm sorry...
Stupid brat getting emo again. What's there to apologize for?
I kept ignoring you and kept you in the pen...
Ugh. Sod off. Got no ears for sniveling nonsense. We should try to piss each other off again. That's what I like.
Boy, think of it this way. This tiny farm is a fount of life. Plenty of seeds will grow out of it. And people will plant those seeds in places further away.
Boy... Someone's tending to the farm and the crops. But what about you? Who's gonna carry you around when I shuffle off this mortal pen?
I ... I'll be okay... I'm tall and strong now. I can reach faraway places without riding... Like, really faraway places.
Okay. That's good to hear. Very good.
Don't be picky with food. Have your meals on time. And work out, dammit. That's the secret to being big and tall.
Mmmhmm... Sweet, sweet release!
Suck it all up, my tender little plants! Grow faster, taller, and fruitier... That's right!
Hooo... Oh my goodness. All this bowel action is really exhausting.
You gave your life to this little farm. And you're still caring about it after retirement. I just...
I just ... it's really not worth your while. You've done more than enough. It's time to move on...
Those tiny seeds have explored the world outside the farm already. They did it for me.
And when I saw this farm, the crops, and their beautiful ears, I should have no regrets.
Is there something you still want to do?
Another burden off this beast.
Hmm...
Good boy... Oh, by the way...
Yes?
Stop adding ginger to the fresh fruit juice... It's disgusting.
Take good care of yourself...
Absolutely! This is the old boy's farm.
Ah, yeeees, this is it... AHHHH... I remember everything.
CAN'T BELIEVE THIS! First thing you do at the place you missed the most ... is to poop on it?

options: You ... you alright?
Need any help?
He's gone... We should leave too.
Ginger? In a fruit punch? Who does that...?
You're still in the mood for arguing?
Just let Little Wu finish, old boy.
Should have no regrets?
So I guess you still regret about something...?
Little Wu, you sure this is the right place?

scenes.summary: Lifeng wakes you up. Turns out Old Burdenbeast and Little Wu are just people from a dream.

lines.text: Why are you sleeping on the lawn? You'll catch a cold!
Academy? I guess you're still blurry from your nap. This is the industrial and agricultural production unit.
You probably dreamed it all up. We got a pro taking care of the burdenbeasts and keeping them safe here.
That Old Burdenbeast in your dream... You probably saw him in real life. Describe him to me. I know all the burdenbeasts here. Maybe I'll find him for you.
That's a little too vague for me. I can't start my search with that...
So...
The Farmers' Meet actually ended early. Shuang and Yan Ning have already left.
An ⟦key|old Tianshi⟧ of the Academy suddenly passed away. Shuang and Yan Ning went to pay their last respects.
Endmin! Wake up! Come on!
They say ... the old man was still very much attached to his experimental farm.

options: The lawn...? I thought I was in the Academy.
Was it really a dream?
Was it just a dream?
He's really special. The others have nothing on him.
He's really common. Just like all the others.
It's alright. You don't have to find him.
It's just a dream... Pay no heed to it.
Where did everyone go?
Is the Farmers' Meet over already?
What happened?
They left? Where did they go?
An Old Burdenbeast just disappeared into the crowd...
An old Tianshi...
That farm...
Who...? What...? Where...? How...?
